reviews_verbatim.text: Armando and his crew are the BEST! They did a bunch of projects at our house from completely gutting and redoing our guest bathroom to closing up and moving our front doors and adding a front porch and doing the entire homes electrical …

reviews_verbatim.author: Alex Austin
reviews_verbatim.text: Armando is the best contractor I ever worked with. He went above and beyond, and truly helped us more than anyone I've ever worked with in the space. If you need a general contractor in Miami, he is the guy!

reviews_verbatim.author: Danny Palacios
reviews_verbatim.text: I hired Toledo Construction for a kitchen remodel. From the first day, they were professional over the phone and face to face. I'm happy with the way my kitchen turned out and the turn around time for the project, which is why I'm writing this review. I highly recommend them for any project and would use them again.

photos_research.note_mixed_content: The listing's 'Photos' tab (shown as '10 Photos' in the UI) contained 8 distinct images after removing exact duplicates. 4 of the 8 show a restaurant interior/exterior ('Agave Bandido' signage visible in one), consistent with this general contractor having done a commercial interior/exterior build-out/renovation for that venue and uploading it to their own Google Business photo album as portfolio work (this matches the business's own 'General contractor' category and reviews describing full remodels/renovations, not just residential). The other 4 show aerial drone shots of roofing work and residential/commercial exterior renovation, clearly on-topic.
